treatment_revision_policy: first clean descendant commit implementing only the preregistered matrix-owned derived_operand contract; record the exact revision in the treatment manifest
agent_instructions: Complete the task in instruction.md using input.json and submission_schema.json. You may use the configured Jacobian MCP tools for exact mathematical work. Write the required submission.json and evidence files in the workspace. Do not use web search.

conditions.description: Current main: matrix.multiply.compute requires two complete explicit RationalMatrix operands.
The identical surface plus one closed matrix-owned derived_operand field that derives exactly one sibling operand by IDENTITY or TRANSPOSE before multiplication.

invariants: the target operand is omitted before validation and resolved exactly once
the resolved explicit source, target, and derivation remain bound in checker input
cycles, two references, JSON pointers, arbitrary expressions, and cross-request references are impossible

tasks.selection_basis: A squared requires reuse of the exact left operand as the right operand.
The fixed proof audit repeatedly requires D transpose times D and D transpose times J times D.
The strict verifier independently recomputes the requested H times H transpose Gram matrix.

decision_gate.keep: Treatment preserves or improves terminal acceptance and demonstrates at least two valid derived-operand calls across at least two task lineages without false certification.
decision_gate.retire: Treatment reduces terminal acceptance, produces false certification, or is unused across the entire frozen matrix.
decision_gate.inconclusive: Any other result remains exploratory and does not justify a generic transform or artifact mechanism.

invariants: same task bytes and Harbor task digests
same agent instructions, model, reasoning effort, timeout, ordering, and repetitions
same task-owned verifier bytes and labels
conditions differ only by the preregistered request-local matrix operand derivation
no automatic retry, strategy instruction, answer content, assurance promotion, or verifier relaxation
stop_rules: preserve every started rollout regardless of outcome
do not rerun model failures or inconclusive outcomes
stop after the frozen twelve-rollout matrix
do not expand beyond sibling IDENTITY and TRANSPOSE derivations based on this study
environment_limitations: No Docker, Podman, or compatible Harbor container runtime is installed on the host.
The digest-recording host runner copies only public task files and invokes the unchanged task verifier in a fresh child process.
Results are exploratory host-local observations and cannot be reported as Harbor or causal evidence.
